source: Regrouped from the project's DWSIM 10.2.3 characterisation of Tia Juana Light (tjl-ledezma2019-dwsim1023-13pc-r1) from the TBP data in Ledezma-Martinez, Design of Crude Oil Distillation Systems with Preflash Units, PhD thesis, University of Manchester (2019), taken from Watkins (1979) via Chen (2008) by constrained mass-CDF reconstruction; DWSIM 10.2.5.0 Riazi-Daubert Tc/Pc; PR78 saturation-fitted omega; mass-conserved caloric interpolation. Estimated heavy extrapolation.

fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the 298.15..900 K caloric fit continued to 293.15 K (the bundled ambient continuation qualified in the fluid-network batch, with the pure-component viscosity tables sampled from 293.15 K); 100 Pa..2 MPa is the span the network evaluates this record over (PR78 with every phase at its own pressure since P3 WP4; above 2 MPa this record is not qualified).

freezing.source: Estimated upper bound: the melting point of the n-paraffin of the fraction's molar mass 937.7667891649681 g/mol (icheme:crude_pc11, revision crude-regrouped-r1), Riazi and Al-Sahhaf, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 34 (1995) 4145, Tm = 397 - exp(6.5096 - 0.14187 M^0.47), fitted for C5..C40 (M about 70..565); this M lies beyond C40, so the value is extrapolated. A fraction freezes over a range (cloud and pour points lie lower). Data only: never a validity floor or a range end.

liquid.source: Twu, Ind. Eng. Chem. Process Des. Dev. 24 (1985) 1287: kinematic viscosity at 100 F and 210 F from this record's normal boiling point and standard density (n-alkane reference plus specific-gravity correction), continued in temperature by the ASTM D341 two-point (Walther) form; dynamic viscosity = kinematic x Rackett saturated-liquid density (Spencer-Danner, Yamada-Gunn Z_RA from this record's acentric factor) anchored at the standard density, held at its critical value above Tc; capped at 1e12 Pa s. Correlation estimate, no measured data; extrapolated beyond the correlation's fitted range for SG >= 1.0 (crude_pc11, crude_pc12). Generated by tools/crude-grades/cut-tables.mjs.

vapor.source: DWSIM 10.2.5.0 AUX_VAPVISCi with reconstructed MW, SG, NBP, Tc, Pc and PR78 omega; estimated vapor continuation
